tasks.title: Conversation #94
tasks.transcript:
Man: Are you planning to go to the local art gallery this weekend?
Woman: Yes, I am. I heard they have a new exhibition by 6 contemporary artists.
Man: That sounds interesting. Do you know when the doors open?
Woman: They open at 4 p.m. on Saturday. Maybe we could go together.
Man: Sure. I'd love to. I can drive. I'll pick you up at 5.

questions.stem: What event are the speakers planning to attend?
questions.analysis: 答案：C 题目问的是：说话者计划参加什么活动？ 定位原文：Man: Are you planning to go to the local art gallery this weekend? Woman: Yes, I am. I heard they have a new exhibition by 6 contemporary artists. 选项分析： A. A concert 音乐会。对话中未提及音乐或演出，所以A选项错误。 B. A theater show 戏剧表演。对话中未提及戏剧，所以B选项错误。 C. An art exhibition 艺术展览。女士明确提到“a new exhibition”，且地点在艺术画廊，所以C选项正确。 D. A book reading 读书会。对话中未提及书籍或朗读活动，所以D选项错误。

答案：A 题目问的是：活动将在什么时候开始？ 定位原文：Woman: They open at 4 p.m. on Saturday. 选项分析： A. 4 p.m. 下午4点。女士明确说周六下午4点开门，所以A选项正确。 B. 5 p.m. 下午5点。这是男士提议接女士的时间，并非活动开始时间，所以B选项错误。 C. 6 p.m. 下午6点。对话中未提及6点，所以C选项错误。 D. 7 p.m. 下午7点。对话中未提及7点，所以D选项错误。
